detail.readme:
**MiniCPM-V & MiniCPM-o · See, hear, and interact on your local devices.**

MiniCPM-V 4.7 🤗 35B-A3B 🤗 1B 🤖   MiniCPM-o 4.5 🤗 🤖

Overview  ·  Get started  ·  Resources  |  中文 · English

## News - [2026.10.28] 🔥🔥🔥 We open-source the [MiniCPM-OCR suite](https://github.com/OpenBMB/MiniCPM-OCR), pairing two models for **fast, accurate parsing and result verification**: **MiniCPM-OCR 1.0** (based on **MiniCPM-V 4.6**, SOTA on Real5-OmniDocBench and OCRBench v2) and **MiniCPM-OCR Jev** for result correctness checks. - **2026-10-15** · We release **DSpark speculative decoding heads** in **BF16 and GGUF** for both MiniCPM-V 4.7 variants: **1B** ([**DSpark-BF16**](https://huggingface.co/openbmb/MiniCPM-V-4.7-1B-DSpark), [**DSpark-GGUF**](https://huggingface.co/openbmb/MiniCPM-V-4.7-1B-DSpark-gguf)) and **35B-A3B** ([**DSpark-BF16**](https://huggingface.co/openbmb/MiniCPM-V-4.7-35B-A3B-DSpark), [**DSpark-GGUF**](https://huggingface.co/openbmb/MiniCPM-V-4.7-35B-A3B-DSpark-gguf)). - **2026-10-12 · MiniCPM-V 4.7 released** — the first open-source MoE model to run smoothly on-device without compromising performance, setting a new multimodal performance–efficiency Pareto frontier. [See what's new](./docs/minicpm_v4dot7_en.md). ## MiniCPM-V 4.7 MiniCPM-V 4.7 is the latest model in the MiniCPM-V series, available in **35B-A3B and 1B variants**. The 35B-A3B variant is the series' first MoE model. Its main features include: - **🚀 A new performance–efficiency Pareto frontier.** The 35B-A3B and 1B variants each advance the performance–efficiency Pareto frontier for multimodal large language models. In Instruct mode, 35B-A3B **achieves a higher overall score in less inference time than Qwen3.6 35B-A3B**; the 1B variant further improves on MiniCPM-V 4.6's core capabilities and **substantially outperforms Qwen3.5 0.8B in both overall score and inference efficiency**. - **📱 The first open-source MoE to run smoothly on-device without compromising performance.** Powered by the latest [Lookahead Expert Scheduling (LES)](https://github.com/OpenBMB/llama.cpp-omni/blob/main/docs/les/lookahead-expert-scheduling.md) inference acceleration technique, MiniCPM-V 4.7 35B-A3B becomes the first open-source MoE model to run smoothly on-device without compromising performance, achieving a **decoding speed of 13+ tokens/s with just 3 GB of memory** on iPhone 17 Pro Max. We also support **DSpark speculative decoding**, with dedicated heads available for **1B** ([**DSpark-BF16**](https://huggingface.co/openbmb/MiniCPM-V-4.7-1B-DSpark), [**DSpark-GGUF**](https://huggingface.co/openbmb/MiniCPM-V-4.7-1B-DSpark-gguf)) and **35B-A3B** ([**DSpark-BF16**](https://huggingface.co/openbmb/MiniCPM-V-4.7-35B-A3B-DSpark), [**DSpark-GGUF**](https://huggingface.co/openbmb/MiniCPM-V-4.7-35B-A3B-DSpark-gguf)). - **🛠️ Broad platform support and easy customization.** MiniCPM-V 4.7 supports **iOS, Android, and HarmonyOS**, and **supports chip platforms from Intel, AMD, Arm, Rockchip, and Houmo**, covering a diverse range of mobile devices and local computing scenarios. We also open-source [Self-Replay Fine-Tuning (SRFT)](https://openbmb.cn/en/blog/self-replay-fine-tuning), helping developers **extend model capabilities at low cost while reducing forgetting of existing capabilities**. ### Significantly Advancing the Performance–Efficiency Pareto Frontier

**Overall Performance (35B-A3B, Instruct)** **Vision-Language**

**Language**

**Overall Performance (1B, Instruct)**

### Smooth On-Device MoE Inference without Compromising Performance Running an MoE model on a device is only the starting point. **The real challenge is to preserve model capability while delivering smooth generation.** Storing expert weights on SSD can overcome memory capacity limits, but frequent loading stalls slow generation unless loading and computation overlap effectively. Restricting the number of experts or fixing an expert subset can speed up inference at the cost of model capability. To address this trade-off, MiniCPM-V 4.7 introduces [Lookahead Expert Scheduling](https://github.com/OpenBMB/llama.cpp-omni/blob/main/docs/les/lookahead-expert-scheduling.md), delivering a **5× speedup on real devices without sacrificing model capability**. Cross-layer routing prediction preloads experts likely to be needed by the next layer and prioritizes computation for experts selected by the actual router that are already loaded, substantially reducing loading stalls. Weight quantization and an optimized storage layout also reduce the storage footprint and make scattered reads more efficient, further accelerating loading. The recording below compares generation speed before and after inference optimization:

[🤗](https://huggingface.co/openbmb/MiniCPM-V-4.7-1B-gguf)  [](https://modelscope.cn/models/OpenBMB/MiniCPM-V-4.7-1B-gguf) **GGUF** | [🤗](https://huggingface.co/openbmb/MiniCPM-V-4.7-1B-DSpark)  [](https://modelscope.cn/models/OpenBMB/MiniCPM-V-4.7-1B-DSpark) **BF16**
[🤗](https://huggingface.co/openbmb/MiniCPM-V-4.7-1B-DSpark-gguf)  [](https://modelscope.cn/models/OpenBMB/MiniCPM-V-4.7-1B-DSpark-gguf) **GGUF** | The 1B int4 variant uses bitsandbytes; AWQ and GPTQ use W4A16 quantization. Quantized variants reduce memory usage; GGUF weights support CPU inference. Also available on [Ollama](https://ollama.com/openbmb/minicpm-v4.7). ## MiniCPM-o 4.5 MiniCPM-o 4.5 is the latest model in the MiniCPM-o series, a **9B end-to-end omnimodal model**. It can continuously receive video and audio while generating speech and text, enabling real-time interactions that see, hear, and speak simultaneously. **Model highlights:** - **🔥 Vision capability approaching Gemini 2.5 Flash.** It scores 77.6 on average across 8 popular OpenCompass benchmarks. **With only 9B parameters, its visual understanding surpasses GPT-4o and Gemini 2.0 Pro**, and a single model supports both instruct and thinking modes. - **🎙 Strong speech capability.** It supports bilingual real-time speech conversation with configurable voices in English and Chinese, making conversations **more natural, expressive, and stable**. A simple reference audio clip is enough for **voice cloning and role play**, and its voice cloning performance surpasses strong TTS tools such as CosyVoice2. - **🎬 Full-duplex, proactive live interaction.** It process real-time, continuous video and audio input streams simultaneously while generating concurrent text and speech output streams in an end-to-end fashion, without mutual blocking. This **allows MiniCPM-o 4.5 to see, hear, and speak simultaneously**, enabling smooth, real-time omnimodal conversations. Beyond responding to requests, the model can also interact proactively, for example by initiating reminders or comments based on its continuous understanding of the scene. ### News - **2026-05-17** · Released [API access](./docs/api.md) for MiniCPM-o 4.5.

detail.readme_zh:
**MiniCPM-V & MiniCPM-o · 把看、听、交互，带到你的端侧设备上。**

MiniCPM-V 4.7 🤗 35B-A3B 🤗 1B 🤖   MiniCPM-o 4.5 🤗 🤖

模型概览  ·  开始使用  ·  项目资源  |  中文 · English

## 最新动态 - [2026.10.28] 🔥🔥🔥 我们开源了 [MiniCPM-OCR 套件](https://github.com/OpenBMB/MiniCPM-OCR)，包含两个模型，兼顾**快速准确解析与质量把关**：**MiniCPM-OCR 1.0**（基于 **MiniCPM-V 4.6**，Real5-OmniDocBench 与 OCRBench v2 SOTA）和用于结果正确性检查的 **MiniCPM-OCR Jev**。 - **2026-10-15** · 我们发布了 MiniCPM-V 4.7 的 **DSpark 投机采样头**，两个尺寸均提供 **BF16 和 GGUF 版本**：**1B**（[**DSpark-BF16**](https://huggingface.co/openbmb/MiniCPM-V-4.7-1B-DSpark)、[**DSpark-GGUF**](https://huggingface.co/openbmb/MiniCPM-V-4.7-1B-DSpark-gguf)）和 **35B-A3B**（[**DSpark-BF16**](https://huggingface.co/openbmb/MiniCPM-V-4.7-35B-A3B-DSpark)、[**DSpark-GGUF**](https://huggingface.co/openbmb/MiniCPM-V-4.7-35B-A3B-DSpark-gguf)）。 - **2026-10-12 · MiniCPM-V 4.7 发布** — 首个端侧无损流畅运行的开源 MoE 模型，刷新多模态性能—效率帕累托前沿。[查看这一代的新变化](./docs/minicpm_v4dot7_zh.md)。 ## MiniCPM-V 4.7 MiniCPM-V 4.7 是 MiniCPM-V 系列的最新模型，提供 **35B-A3B 和 1B 两种规格**，其中 35B-A3B 是 MiniCPM-V 系列首个 MoE 模型。主要特点包括： - **🚀 性能与效率的新帕累托前沿。** MiniCPM-V 4.7 以 35B-A3B 与 1B 分别刷新了多模态大模型的性能—效率的帕累托前沿。在 Instruct 模式下，35B-A3B **以更短的推理时间取得比 Qwen3.6 35B-A3B 更高的综合得分**；1B 版本相比 MiniCPM-V 4.6 持续提升基础能力，并在**综合得分和推理效率上均显著领先 Qwen3.5 0.8B**。 - **📱 首个端侧无损流畅的开源 MoE**。基于最新的 [LES（前瞻专家调度）](https://github.com/OpenBMB/llama.cpp-omni/blob/main/docs/les/lookahead-expert-scheduling.zh.md) 推理加速技术，MiniCPM-V 4.7 35B-A3B 成为首个支持端侧无损流畅运行的开源 MoE 模型，在 iPhone 17 Pro Max 上以**仅 3GB 内存**达到 **13+ token/s 的解码速度**。我们也适配了 **DSpark 投机采样**，并提供 **1B**（[**DSpark-BF16**](https://huggingface.co/openbmb/MiniCPM-V-4.7-1B-DSpark)、[**DSpark-GGUF**](https://huggingface.co/openbmb/MiniCPM-V-4.7-1B-DSpark-gguf)）和 **35B-A3B**（[**DSpark-BF16**](https://huggingface.co/openbmb/MiniCPM-V-4.7-35B-A3B-DSpark)、[**DSpark-GGUF**](https://huggingface.co/openbmb/MiniCPM-V-4.7-35B-A3B-DSpark-gguf)）的投机采样头。 - **🛠️ 多平台支持，开发者友好。** MiniCPM-V 4.7 同时支持 iOS、安卓和鸿蒙，并适配Intel、AMD、Arm、瑞芯微、后摩等芯片平台，覆盖更多移动设备与本地计算场景。同步开源 [Self-Replay Fine-Tuning (SRFT)](https://openbmb.cn/blog/self-replay-fine-tuning) 微调方案，帮助开发者低成本扩展模型能力和减少遗忘，方便二次开发。 ### 刷新性能与推理效率的帕累托前沿

**完整性能对比（35B-A3B，Instruct）** **Vision-Language**

**Language**

**完整性能对比（1B，Instruct）**

### 无损且流畅的 MoE 端侧推理 让 MoE 在端侧运行只是起点，**真正的挑战是同时保留模型能力与流畅的生成速度**。将专家权重存放在 SSD 中可以突破内存容量限制，但若加载与计算无法有效并行，频繁的加载等待就会拖慢生成；限制专家数量、固定专家集合等方式虽能提速，却可能以模型能力退化为代价。 为了解决这一两难问题，MiniCPM-V 4.7 提出[前瞻专家调度技术](https://github.com/OpenBMB/llama.cpp-omni/blob/main/docs/les/lookahead-expert-scheduling.zh.md)，**在不牺牲模型能力条件下实现 x5 的端侧真实加速**。通过跨层路由预测，提前加载下一层可能用到的专家并优先计算已加载的专家，显著减少了加载等待时间；同时，结合权重量化与存储布局优化策略，减少权重存储重和读取分散的问题，显著提升加载速度。推理优化前后的生成速度对比：

[🤗](https://huggingface.co/openbmb/MiniCPM-V-4.7-35B-A3B-FP8)  [](https://modelscope.cn/models/OpenBMB/MiniCPM-V-4.7-35B-A3B-FP8) **FP8**

[🤗](https://huggingface.co/openbmb/MiniCPM-V-4.7-35B-A3B-AWQ)  [](https://modelscope.cn/models/OpenBMB/MiniCPM-V-4.7-35B-A3B-AWQ) **AWQ**
